payload.text: **0088's two proposed-high rows wait on hv's routing through vc** (census filed at f8e3213): row 2, run_gate hands every gated tool the terminal as stdin; row 3, release_read_remote's git ls-remote asks for a credential on /dev/tty. Also 0086's behavioural arm on run_tty_eof (bare mv exits 0 unreplaced, -f replaces). 0086 itself is vc's to close; round three (allowlist) at 2457113 is with vc.
